name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix delivered the sharpest V-shaped reversal in weeks: opened -3.5% as Iran's Strait of Hormuz closure dragged the KOSPI to a -4% intraday low, then surged to close +2.59% at ₩2,101,000 after Chairman Chey announced a plan to triple wafer production capacity by 2034 and reports surfaced of an August US ADR listing targeting $14B. The KOSPI recovered to +0.43%. The won strengthened to ₩1,525/USD from ₩1,548 — a meaningful tailwind for the 54%-foreign-owned float. Bulls captured the full intraday reversal; two structural re-rating catalysts have arrived.
long_pnl: +2.59% — longs who held through the Hormuz open dip collected a ~6% intraday swing from the -3.5% low
short_pnl: −2.59% — shorts pressed the Hormuz gap-down and got squeezed hard on the capacity announcement

decision.rationale: Upgrading from HOLD to BUY at low conviction. Two structural catalysts emerged today not in yesterday's calculus: (1) Chairman Chey's announcement to triple wafer capacity by 2034 confirms management is investing ahead of a generational AI-memory demand curve — a company worried about demand does not make this commitment; (2) the August US ADR listing at a potential $14B opens SK Hynix to US index inclusion, passive forced-buying, and a valuation re-rating toward US-listed peers (Micron). The won has strengthened to ₩1,525/USD (from ₩1,548), reducing FX drag. The recovery trigger of ₩2,200,000 has not been hit yet, and FOMC on June 17 remains a binary risk — a hawkish Fed spikes the dollar and renews selling. BUY at low conviction: initiate or add a partial position here; complete the position on a daily close above ₩2,200,000. Stop at ₩1,900,000 (circuit-breaker zone).

what_traders_are_doing: Two parallel trades in play. (1) **Short-covering**: five sessions of forced selling (FX hedges, margin calls, global risk-off) built a large short base; the capacity expansion and won recovery gave fundamental longs a reason to buy aggressively — SK Hynix closed +2.59% on a KOSPI that only gained 0.43%. (2) **ADR positioning**: smart money is sizing up ahead of the US listing because US institutions that can't hold Korean-listed shares directly will be able to buy in August; if included in Russell/S&P indexes, passive forced-buying follows automatically. The ADR listing is a re-rating catalyst, not just a liquidity event.

analysis:
## The V-shaped reversal

SK Hynix opened June 11 in full crisis mode — [Iran formally closed the Strait of Hormuz](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-june-11-2026), sending the KOSPI to a -4% intraday low and dragging SK Hynix to ₩1,960,000 (-3.5% from the prior close). Then two catalysts flipped the session:

**Chairman Chey's capacity declaration.** [SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won announced](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4602561-sk-hynix-chairman-says-company-will-triple-wafer-capacity-by-2034) that SK Hynix will triple its wafer production capacity by 2034 — from ~550K wafers/month today to ~1M wpm by 2030, then a full threefold scale by 2034. The first Yongin cluster fab begins operations in 2027. This is a generational commitment to the AI memory cycle. It is the supply-side mirror of NVIDIA's demand-side confirmation that HBM is not optional for AI computing. A company uncertain about demand does not triple production capacity.

**The US ADR listing.** [Reports confirmed](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sk-hynix-u-stock-listing-143737920.html) that SK Hynix is targeting an August US listing via ADR at a potential offering size of $14B — one of the largest ADR raises in history. SEC clearance is expected around June 22. This is the catalyst that changes the shareholder base structurally: US-listed SK Hynix becomes eligible for Russell and potentially S&P index inclusion, forcing billions in passive buying from funds that currently cannot hold the Korean-listed shares. The ADR pricing process will re-anchor the market's view of fair value — at Micron's current P/E multiple, SK Hynix would trade at a significant premium to its current KRX price, and that re-rating pulls the Korean-listed shares up with it.

## Technical analysis

The trend read: **first recovery session after five-day downtrend; reversal confirmed but not yet extended.** SK Hynix had five consecutive down sessions losing 14.9% from ATH. Today's close at ₩2,101,000 from an intraday low of ₩1,960,000 is the first genuine bull session in that stretch.

**Volume:** Estimated ~5M shares traded — slightly above recent averages (~4.9M). Volume expanding on the recovery is a mild positive signal — this was not just thin short-covering; fundamental buyers participated.

**Momentum:** The stock reclaimed ₩2,100,000 on the close — psychologically important. The RSI entered the session deeply oversold and recovered, though it remains in bearish territory below 50.

**★ Strongest support: ₩2,000,000–₩2,048,000.** The ₩2,000,000 round number is the primary anchor. It was tested as an intraday level on June 10 (low ₩1,992,000) and June 11 (low ₩1,960,000 — briefly breaking the round number before recovering). Three sessions of high volume traded in this range create a significant buying shelf. A daily close below ₩2,000,000 would invalidate the support and target ₩1,900,000.

**★ Strongest resistance: ₩2,200,000.** This represents the prior dossier's re-entry trigger, aligns with the rolling 200-DMA region and the zone where the stock broke down in the June 10 selloff, and is the level that needs to be reclaimed on volume to confirm the recovery. A daily close above ₩2,200,000 = add to full position.

**Decision points:** ₩2,200,000 close on above-average volume = add to full position. ₩1,900,000 break = stop out. FOMC June 17 is the macro gating event for everything in between.

## Why the ADR is underpriced by the market

The US listing deserves more attention than it currently receives. SK Hynix trades only on the Korea Exchange — accessible to Korean investors and some foreign institutional desks, but not to US retail, US ETF funds tracking domestic indexes, or funds with mandates restricted to US-listed securities. A $14B ADR offering changes that entirely.

The valuation argument is straightforward: Micron Technology — SK Hynix's nearest US-listed comparable — trades at a P/E multiple significantly higher than SK Hynix's Korean-listed valuation, partly because of the US listing premium and broader analyst/investor coverage. SK Hynix, as [NVIDIA's exclusive advanced HBM3E supplier](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4602561-sk-hynix-chairman-says-company-will-triple-wafer-capacity-by-2034) with superior AI-memory technology, should trade at a *premium* to Micron, not a discount. The ADR closes that gap. Investors who understand this trade are sizing into the Korean-listed shares now, before the US listing reprices the stock upward.
